paragraphs.text: It is commonly argued that social media has made people lonelier. The evidence for this claim is, in my opinion, far from convincing. Most studies show only small correlations between time spent online and loneliness, and they cannot tell us which causes which: lonely people may simply spend more time on social media. That said, I accept that certain uses, such as endlessly comparing oneself with others, are likely to be harmful.

groups.tip: "It is commonly argued" başkalarının görüşü; "in my opinion", "I accept" yazarın.
